description: This file defines a ViewModel named BookmarksViewModel for managing bookmark-related UI state and actions within an Android app. It handles observing bookmarked news resources, removing and undoing removals, and updating viewed status.

classes.name: BookmarksViewModel
classes.description: A ViewModel managing the bookmarked news resources, including loading state, bookmark removal, undo functionality, and viewed state updates.

methods.name: removeFromSavedResources
methods.description: Removes a news resource from saved bookmarks and updates UI state to show undo option.

methods.name: setNewsResourceViewed
methods.description: Marks a news resource as viewed or not.

methods.name: undoBookmarkRemoval
methods.description: Restores the last removed bookmark if undo is triggered.
